title: Hatya
desc: Sagar brings home a boy and treats him like his younger brother only to find out that the police suspect Sagar as the killer of the boy's mother.

title: Toofan
desc: Balbir Singh stands up against a tyrannical chief minister, fighting for the oppressed citizens who suffer under a regime that uses the king's name to justify its cruelty.

title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: Arun blames God for his troubles, but when God appears and grants him divine powers, Arun tries to make the world better by fulfilling everyone's wishes.

title: Loafer
desc: Ravi, an unemployed man, is framed for a gangster's murder. With no support from his family, he must fight alone to prove his innocence.

title: Vicky Donor
desc: Vicky, a young man, becomes a sperm donor at Dr. Baldev's fertility clinic, leading to humorous and heartwarming events as he navigates unexpected responsibilities.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Ground Zero
desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain
desc: Ganga, a kind-hearted villager raised by foster parents, returns to his biological family in the city but struggles to adjust to modern life and its contrasting values.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Toofaan
desc: An orphan surviving on the streets of Mumbai grows into a feared thug, but his path shifts when he meets Ananya, who inspires him to rise above his past and discover his true calling in boxing.

title: Teri Meherbaniyan
desc: After Ram, a kind-hearted government officer, is murdered for defending a village from oppression, his loyal dog Moti becomes the unlikely avenger. Witnessing the crime, Moti sets out to punish the killers and bring justice to his master's memory.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: English Vinglish
desc: Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Cirkus
desc: Chaos erupts when two pairs of twins, separated at birth, unknowingly arrive in the same city. Their identical faces spark nonstop confusion, misunderstandings, and hilarious mayhem.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.
